source.title: Repository integration head-of-line blocking: repo-integrator serializes codex-roadmap PRs behind an earlier PR (#6090,
source.objective: Repository integration head-of-line blocking: repo-integrator serializes codex-roadmap PRs behind an earlier PR (#6090, then #7168), causing unrelated later P0/C3-critical patches to remain queue-behind-earlier even when isolated and fully tested. Replace strict repository-wide FIFO with conflict-aware ordering: permit independent PRs whose tested heads are current and whose changed paths/resource ownership do not conflict; retain serialization only for genuinely conflicting writer/integration state.

source.description: Fresh 2026-10-02 evidence for wi:a6def01900b3499aab85b99a9492a199: repo-integrator left PR #6090 at the head of the codex-roadmap queue even though its owning C3 work item wi:feddc63cc21941a3b386c107350e0b4c was already cancelled as duplicate. #6090 became merge-conflicting as main evolved and blocked new PR #9997 with queue-behind-earlier until manual conflict reconciliation. Prevent cancelled/superseded ownership from leaving stale PRs as head-of-line blockers: terminal ownership should trigger bounded integration review/retirement or allow later safe PRs to progress without resurrecting obsolete work.
